This plot is only 0.06 hectares, so it is a small piece I keep near the house for mixed crops to feed my family. I do not buy chemical fertilizer for it — I save those inputs for my larger cereal plots, and anyway this intercropped piece does not need it like teff or maize do. But I do spread manure and compost here because we have cattle and it costs nothing. I will plant with seeds I kept from last season, and my children and I will tend it ourselves — no need to pay workers for such a small plot.
